dec.pe: Chinese families who had overstayed their visas faced removal, and their children were born in New Zealand. The Supreme Court said officials must properly consider what removal would mean for the children.
dec.pi: Keluarga Tiongkok yang melebihi masa visa akan dikeluarkan, dan anak-anak mereka lahir di Selandia Baru. MA menyatakan pejabat harus menimbang dengan benar dampak pengusiran bagi anak-anak.

dec.n: Teitiota v. Chief Executive, Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment
dec.pe: A man from Kiribati said he could not go home because the sea was swallowing his island. The Supreme Court refused his claim but left the door open for future cases.
dec.pi: Seorang pria dari Kiribati mengatakan ia tidak bisa pulang karena laut menenggelamkan pulaunya. MA menolak permohonannya tetapi membuka kemungkinan bagi perkara di masa depan.

dec.pe: After he was sent back, the man took his case to the UN Human Rights Committee. It found no breach, but said that in future returning people to places made unliveable by climate change could break the treaty.
dec.pi: Setelah dipulangkan, pria itu membawa perkaranya ke Komite HAM PBB. Komite tidak menemukan pelanggaran, tetapi menyatakan di masa depan memulangkan orang ke tempat yang tidak layak huni akibat perubahan iklim bisa melanggar perjanjian.
